map.直线法年折旧 = (原值 − 残值)/年限；双倍余额递减 = 期初净值 × 2/: Straight-line annual depreciation = (cost − salvage) / life; double-declining = opening net book value × 2 / life; sum-of-years-digits = (cost − salvage) × remaining years / sum of years

map.年折旧 = (原值 - 残值)/ 使用年限。设备原值 10万、残值 1万、用 9: Annual depreciation = (cost − salvage) / useful life. Asset cost 100k, salvage 10k, life 9 years → annual depreciation 10k, same each year, book value falls linearly.
map.加速折旧：前期折旧多、后期少（如直线率两倍 × 账面值）。前期抵税多、现金流好，: Accelerated depreciation: more early, less late (e.g. twice the straight-line rate × book value). More early tax shield, better cash flow, but must handle the salvage floor.
map.直线法每年等额，简单直观；加速法（双倍余额递减、年数总和）前期多提，匹配资产效能: Straight-line is equal each year, simple; accelerated (DDB, SYD) front-loads, matching declining asset utility and deferring tax. Tax law often limits the options.
map.折旧是费用，减少账面利润与应税所得（节税），但不影响现金流；处置时残值与账面差产: Depreciation is an expense that reduces book profit and taxable income (tax saving) but not cash flow; on disposal the gap between salvage and book value yields disposal gain/loss.
